title: Earned Wage Access Bundle Percentage on Completed-Month Platform Fees — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Rider Schedule
content:
**Schedule clause.** The Earned Wage Access bundle percentage on the platform fee of a completed billing month of a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service depends on when the employer's Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement went live: an employer whose agreement is live and went live on or before the first day of the billing month earns its tier's Earned Wage Access bundle discount figure, one whose live agreement went live after the first day of the billing month earns that percentage scaled by the part of the month left after go-live, two thirds for a go-live on or before day 10, one third for a go-live after day 10 but no later than day 20 and nothing for a later go-live, and an employer with no live agreement, or one that went live after the billing month, earns no bundle percentage. This bundle percentage applies to the platform fee of a completed billing month only, which is rounded half up to the cent; the closing month of a service is reduced under the rule for the closing month.

The agreement's status and go-live date are read from the employer's Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement record.

| Tier of the disbursement service | Went live on or before day 1 of the billing month | Went live on day 2 to day 10 | Went live on day 11 to day 20 | Went live after day 20, after the billing month, or no live agreement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Instant Pay Starter | 0 percent | two thirds of 0 percent | one third of 0 percent | none |
| Paystride Instant Pay Core | 50 percent | two thirds of 50 percent | one third of 50 percent | none |
| Paystride Instant Pay Growth | 50 percent | two thirds of 50 percent | one third of 50 percent | none |
| Paystride Instant Pay Pro | 25 percent | two thirds of 25 percent | one third of 25 percent | none |
| Paystride Instant Pay Scale | 25 percent | two thirds of 25 percent | one third of 25 percent | none |
| Paystride Instant Pay Enterprise | 25 percent | two thirds of 25 percent | one third of 25 percent | none |

The scaled percentage is the exact fraction of the figure; the platform fee alone is rounded, once.

## Boundary days (hypothetical)

- Go-live on day 1 of the billing month: the full figure. Day 2: two thirds of it.
- Day 10: two thirds. Day 11: one third. Day 20: one third. Day 21: none.
- Go-live in the month after the billing month: none for that billing month.
